narrationVisualMode.description: Optional complete-cue content reveal for steps. Omitted preserves the approved original appearance. Never infer cue times from text length.

narrationLayout.description: Optional new-production spacing for lists, steps, comparisons and cards. Omitted preserves approved geometry. No action/sound/caption clock changes.

captionPosition.description: Optional portrait publish-preview ratios, chosen by the assistant after viewing the intended interface. Defaults bottom .24, left .08, right .16. Editorial preset, not an official device/platform guarantee.

captionSafeArea.description: Portrait uses an editorial bottom/right UI reserve. frame retains previous positioning for explicit legacy replay. Landscape defaults are unchanged.

language.description: Current package language; not an automatic translation or capacity override.

narrationComposition.description: Explicit new-production recipe resolved by the normal source-bound entry before review. No legacy migration or generated step/word cues. See NARRATION-VISUAL.md.

captionAlignment.description: Center captions on the complete output frame by default. content-center uses the left content region while a landscape presenter card is visible.

narrationVisualMode.description: Optional complete-cue content reveal for steps. Omitted preserves the approved original appearance. Never infer cue times from text length.

narrationCardLayout.description: Optional content-sized icon cards with focus clearance and grouped heading. Omitted preserves approved old composition; no cue or sound changes.

narrationLayout.description: Optional new-production spacing for lists, steps, comparisons and cards. Omitted preserves approved geometry. No action/sound/caption clock changes.

captionPosition.description: Optional portrait publish-preview ratios, chosen by the assistant after viewing the intended interface. Defaults bottom .24, left .08, right .16. Editorial preset, not an official device/platform guarantee.

captionSafeArea.description: Portrait uses an editorial bottom/right UI reserve. frame retains previous positioning for explicit legacy replay. Landscape defaults are unchanged.

language.description: Current package language; not an automatic translation or capacity override.

highlightReadability.description: Explicit new highlight composition: keep complete marked groups at native preferred font, and clear text through a final ending=cut without changing duration, voice/caption/cue/SFX clocks. Omit for original. See NARRATION-VISUAL.md.

captionLayout.description: Explicit bottom-caption balanced word/punctuation typography, original font/text/times, original mode if absent. See NARRATION-VISUAL.md.

narrationComposition.description: Explicit new-production recipe resolved by the normal source-bound entry before review. No legacy migration or generated step/word cues. See NARRATION-VISUAL.md.

description: Original native input contract or explicit workflow:motion-kit; never select the extension implicitly.
